privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introText: At Innovation Ladders, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use the SkyProperties platform.
privacyPolicy.dataCollectionText: We collect information you provide directly to us when registering on the platform, including name, email, and phone number. We also automatically collect information about your use of the platform.
privacyPolicy.dataUsageText: We use your information to provide and improve our services, communicate with you, personalize your experience, and ensure platform security. We will not share your personal information with third parties without your consent.
privacyPolicy.dataSecurityText: We take strict security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction. We use encryption technologies and advanced security protocols.
privacyPolicy.userRightsText: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You may also object to data processing or request restriction of its use. To exercise these rights, please contact us.
privacyPolicy.cookiesText: We use cookies to improve your experience and analyze platform usage. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
privacyPolicy.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes via email or through a prominent notice on the platform.
privacyPolicy.contactText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

termsOfService.serviceDescriptionText: SkyProperties provides a comprehensive platform for managing residential and commercial properties and units, including ticket management, contracts, billing, permits, and more.
termsOfService.userResponsibilitiesText: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. You are also responsible for all activities that occur under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
termsOfService.prohibitedUsesText: You are prohibited from using the platform for any illegal purpose or prohibited by these terms. This includes but is not limited to: posting offensive content, violating intellectual property rights, attempting unauthorized access to our systems.
termsOfService.intellectualPropertyText: All rights and intellectual property in the platform and its content are owned by Innovation Ladders. You may not copy, modify, or distribute any part of the platform without our written permission.
termsOfService.limitationText: We shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use or inability to use the platform.
termsOfService.terminationText: We reserve the right to terminate or suspend your access to the platform immediately, without prior notice, for any reason, including violation of these terms.
termsOfService.changesText: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Modifications will be posted on this page and your continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.
termsOfService.governingLawText: These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
